product_summary: Labindia group (since 1982) operates as an Indian manufacturer + channel partner/importer of laboratory analytical instruments. Own-brand lines (labindia-analytical.com): UV-VIS spectrophotometers (UV 1000/2000/3000/3100/3200), AAS (AA 8000/8000Z), FT-IR (Nicolet Summit X - Thermo brand), ICP-OES 5000 DV, ICP-MS 5500, benchtop XRD, ED-XRF/handheld XRF (Elva X, Prospector), C&S analysers (LCS3500), spark OES (LABSPECTRO), Kjeldahl/Dumas/Soxhlet/fibre food analysers (Labkjel, LabDumas, Labsox, LabFiber), Karl Fischer titrators, polarimeters, refractometers, bomb calorimeters, dissolution testers DS 8000/14000, disintegration/friability/hardness/leak/tap-density testers, glassware washers, chamber/tube furnaces. Distribution arm (labindiainstruments.com) adds chromatography systems and consumables, Biotage synthesis/purification/SPE platforms, microscopes (AFM, SEM, Raman, upright/inverted), TapeStation, NGS, microarray, lithography/plasma tools, freeze dryers, density meters, petroleum testing (flash point, sulphur-in-oil, viscosity, four-ball tester), particle characterization, pipettes.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader (own-brand manufacture of analytical instruments plus importer/distributor of third-party brands such as Thermo Scientific, Biotage, WPI)
comment: Declared codes 842199 (parts of filtering machinery), 850440 (static converters) and 903180 (measuring/checking instruments n.e.s.) do not reflect the core business. The dominant product lines are laboratory optical/chromatographic/thermal analysis instruments, which belong to 9027 (902730 spectrophotometers, 902720 chromatography, 902780/902789 other physical/chemical analysers) and 8419 (dryers/furnaces/heat-treatment equipment). 903180 is only partially relevant (physical testers, leak tester, four-ball tester, oil condition monitoring) — partial match. 842199 and 850440 look like accessory/parts lines (filters, scrubbers, power supplies) rather than the main goods; no customs line was available to corroborate them, so they are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a misclassification: the company is primarily a pharma/life-science/materials-science laboratory instrument supplier; petroleum/petrochemical testing is only one of many application segments (flash point, sulphur-in-oil, viscosity, spectral fuel analysis). Trader signs: extensive third-party brand portfolio (Thermo Scientific, Biotage, WPI, Elva X, Spinsolve) and separate distribution website — importer/reseller activity alongside own manufacture. Product lines missing from the declaration: spectrophotometers/spectrometers (9027), chromatography systems and consumables (9027), elemental/food analysers (9027), dissolution and tablet physical testers (9027), freeze dryers and laboratory furnaces (8419), microscopes and semiconductor metrology tools (9011/9012/9030), pipettes (9018). Per rule 3 the company is retained; HS codes should be corrected to the 9027/8419 core with 903180 kept as secondary. All product data sourced from labindiainstruments.com and labindia-analytical.com product catalogues (accessed via http_get); no customs/B-L records were checked in this task, so shipment-level corroboration is null.
